title: Support Callbacks and Account Statements on a Personal Sender Account
content:
## Callbacks

A support callback can be scheduled for any Personal Sender Account that is not closed — pending verification, active, locked, restricted or suspended.

## Account statements

A statement can be requested for any Personal Sender Account except one still pending verification, including a closed account within record retention.

- **Period.** The first day of the period may be no earlier than the request date minus the level's statement history in calendar months (same day of the month, falling back to the month's last day), and the last day of the period no later than the request date.
- **Yearly number.** At most the level's number of statements per rolling 12 months may be requested, counted as the statement requests dated on or after the same calendar day 12 months before the handling date (falling back to the month's last day when that day does not exist), including the new one. A request beyond that is not taken until the window frees.
- **Charge and delivery.** Statements are free of charge and are emailed to the address on the customer profile.

| Account status | Callback | Statement |
|---|---|---|
| pending verification | may be scheduled | may not be requested |
| active, locked, restricted, suspended | may be scheduled | may be requested |
| closed | may not be scheduled | may be requested within record retention |

**Period boundary (hypothetical dates).** At a level whose statement history is 24 calendar months, a statement requested on 15 August of a given year may begin no earlier than 15 August two years before; a period beginning on 14 August two years before reaches too far back. A statement requested on 29 February of a leap year at a level whose statement history is 12 calendar months may begin no earlier than 28 February of the year before, the last day of that shorter month. The dates are hypothetical.

## Retired clauses

The following clauses are no longer in force:

- the clause that set a callback's due date as the request date plus the level's callback time in Paloma business days (Monday to Friday, excluding US Federal Reserve holidays);
- the clause that a level with a dedicated support line is called back from the priority line and a level with a named relationship manager is called back by that manager, neither changing the due date;
- the clause that set a statement's delivery due date as the request date plus the level's statement delivery time in Paloma business days.

The due dates of callbacks and of statements are now fixed on the current bases for the callback windows and the statement delivery window.

superseded_clauses: Its callback_due_date is the request date plus the level's callback_sla_business_days Paloma business days (Monday to Friday, excluding US Federal Reserve holidays).

A level with dedicated_support_line true is called back from the priority line, and a level with relationship_manager_assigned true is called back by the named relationship manager; neither changes the due date.
delivery_due_date is the request date plus statement_delivery_business_days Paloma business days.
